findings.evidence: The claim permits a sequence a_k downarrow 0 without requiring a_k>0. Taking X_n=1/n deterministically, X=0, a_k=0, and any summable positive b_k<1 makes X_n converge in probability but P(|X_{n_k}-X|>a_k)=1 for every n_k, so the required selection is impossible. The invoked probability-convergence definition only supplies indices for positive thresholds.
